title: Allow us to enable the new token-efficient-tools header please
body:
> Good news for [@AnthropicAI](https://x.com/AnthropicAI)
>  devs:
> 
> We shipped a more token-efficient tool use implementation for 3.7 Sonnet that uses on average 14% less tokens under-the-hood and shows marked improvement in tool use performance.
> 
> Use this beta header: "token-efficient-tools-2025-02-19"
-- [@alexalbert__ on X.com](https://x.com/alexalbert__/status/1894807853371990087)

However looking under the hood I only see `token-efficient-tools-2024-12-11` mentioned.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/990561eb-4f59-4801-a7b8-5f2c49830485)


If I could save 14% on my tokens I'd likely just use Claude Code even more :grin:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/575be3b0-331a-435e-8f15-0de1afe9db23)
author: gerrywastaken
